name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.2.0

itemsEn: Supported the Minimal Agent Preset on Windows through native WSL Linux Bash aligned with official DeepSeek RL training distribution.
Injected a dedicated Win32 ProcessInspector stub and isolated danger-full-access sandbox policy for WSL persistent shell sessions.
Added WSL environment diagnostic and guidance dialog in the desktop menu with one-click 'wsl --install' command copy.
Implemented runtime launch error interception and actionable bilingual troubleshooting guidance for missing WSL environments.
itemsZh: 在 Windows 平台通过 WSL Linux 原生 Bash 正式支持极简模式（Minimal Preset），完美对齐 DeepSeek 官方 RL 训练环境。
引入 Win32 终端进程检查器桩，并在极简预设中启用 danger-full-access 隔离沙箱策略，彻底解决持久终端会话与 Hyper-V 权限问题。
在桌面菜单中新增 WSL 运行环境状态显示与自检入口，支持一键复制 'wsl --install' 安装命令。
实现运行时启动错误拦截与中英文双语友好排错指引，清晰提示标准模式（PowerShell）与极简模式差异。

itemsEn: Hardened WSL availability probe by stripping UTF-16 BOM and validating installed Linux distributions.
Added automatic background re-probing when opening desktop menus for real-time environment refresh.
itemsZh: 强化 WSL 可用性探测逻辑，自动剥离 UTF-16 BOM 并校验有效发行版列表，杜绝误判。
在展开桌面菜单时引入毫秒级动态重探测机制，用户安装 WSL 后免重启即刻刷新状态。

body:
## New Features / 新功能

- Supported Minimal Agent Preset on Windows via WSL Linux Bash. / 在 Windows 平台通过 WSL 原生 Bash 正式支持极简模式。
- Injected Win32 ProcessInspector stub and full-access policy for WSL sessions. / 引入 Win32 终端检查器桩并启用 Full Access 沙箱策略。
- Added WSL diagnostic & guidance entry in desktop menu with 1-click install command copy. / 桌面菜单新增 WSL 状态自检与一键复制安装命令。
- Intercepted runtime launch errors with actionable bilingual guidance. / 运行时启动失败拦截并提供中英文双语排错引导。

## Improvements / 体验优化

- Hardened WSL probe with BOM stripping and distribution checks. / 修复 WSL 探测 BOM 剥离与发行版校验。
- Added on-demand re-probing on menu open. / 菜单展开时支持毫秒级重探测保鲜。

itemsEn: Refused to remove user data through a junction or symlink during uninstallation to prevent accidental file deletion.
Terminated the complete backend engine process tree before uninstallation and fixed percent sign escaping in the delayed self-removal script.
Fixed duplicate PATH entries in the installer by comparing environment variable paths case-insensitively.
Hardened installation and update extraction against Zip Slip path traversal violations.
itemsZh: 卸载时拒绝穿透目录联接（Junction）或符号链接删除用户数据，防止误删外部目录数据。
卸载前先完整终止后台引擎进程树，并修复延迟自清理脚本中百分号未转义的问题。
修复安装程序向系统 PATH 写入路径时的重复问题，改为不区分大小写比对。
强化安装与更新解压流程对 Zip Slip 路径穿越攻击的防御拦截。

itemsEn: Throttled automatic update checks to once per day to eliminate unnecessary startup network traffic.
Implemented exponential backoff for backend health probes when consecutive connection failures accumulate.
Separated the release history cache out of config.json for cleaner state management.
Enforced strict HTTP/HTTPS protocol validation on external window-open requests.
itemsZh: 限制后台自动检查更新频率为每天一次，减少不必要的启动网络请求。
后台引擎连续连接失败时引入指数退避探测机制，避免频繁重试消耗系统资源。
将更新历史缓存从 config.json 中剥离解耦，保持主配置干净整洁。
对外部窗口打开请求强制校验 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，提升安全性。

history.name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.1.2

itemsEn: Fixed the update log ignoring the app language: release notes now prefer the bundled bilingual content, so a Chinese interface shows Chinese release notes instead of the English text pulled from the GitHub release page.
itemsZh: 修复更新日志不跟随界面语言的问题：更新日志改为优先使用内置的中英双语内容，中文界面下现在显示中文更新说明，而不再回退到 GitHub 发布页的英文正文。

itemsEn: Bundled bilingual release history for all published versions (v1.1.1, v1.1.0, v1.0.0), so the full timeline stays localized even when offline or behind a restricted network.
itemsZh: 内置全部已发布版本（v1.1.1、v1.1.0、v1.0.0）的中英双语更新历史，离线或受限网络环境下时间线同样显示本地化文案。

history.name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.1.1

itemsEn: Fixed in-app updates not starting after restart confirmation: the updater is now launched so Windows PowerShell 5.1 actually executes it (the previous detached launch exited silently, leaving the update stuck at "starting" and reporting "last update incomplete" on the next launch).

Fixed updater self-termination risk during shell shutdown: the old desktop shell is terminated without recursively killing its process tree, so the running updater can no longer be killed by its own cleanup.
Fixed unexplained incomplete-update states: early updater failures (for example a missing updater module) now record a concrete failed status with the real error message.
itemsZh: 修复应用内确认重启后更新不执行的问题：更新器改为以 Windows PowerShell 5.1 可正常执行的方式启动（此前分离式启动会静默退出，更新一直卡在 "starting"，下次启动提示"上次更新未完成"）。
修复更新器在关闭旧外壳时可能被误杀的问题：旧桌面外壳改为单进程终止，不再递归击杀其进程树，运行中的更新器不会再被自己的清理逻辑杀死。
修复无法解释的"更新未完成"状态：更新器早期失败（如更新模块缺失）现在会写入包含真实错误信息的具体失败状态。

itemsEn: Console updates (在线更新.bat / update.cmd) reuse a previously downloaded, SHA-256 verified update package, so updating after a failed in-app restart does not re-download.
The post-update launch no longer forces a hidden initial window; the new version's splash and window appear normally.
itemsZh: 控制台更新（在线更新.bat / update.cmd）会复用先前已下载并通过 SHA-256 校验的更新包，应用内重启失败后无需重复下载。
更新完成后不再强制隐藏初始窗口，新版本的启动过渡页与主窗口正常展示。

history.name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.1.0

itemsEn: Added PowerShell (pwsh) shell support and cmdline execution for the Minimal agent preset on Windows.
Adopted immersive titlebar layout with safe content top offset and draggable region, preventing overlay conflicts with window controls.
Reworked update and rollback feedback: added starting/rolled-back status indicators, automatic app relaunch after rollback, and localized status cards.
Added cross-restart Ready Resume for downloaded updates with package integrity verification and startup stale package cleanup.
itemsZh: Windows 极简 Agent 预设支持 PowerShell (pwsh) 执行器与 cmdline 命令行适配。
采用沉浸式标题栏布局，增加顶部安全内容边距与窗口拖拽区域，避免与系统窗口控制按钮重叠冲突。
重构更新与回滚体验：增加更新回滚状态感知、回滚后自动重启恢复，并提供多语言状态卡片。
支持更新包就绪状态跨进程恢复（Ready Resume），启动时自动校验已下载的安装包，并定期清理过期临时文件。

itemsEn: Disabled background jobs (run_in_background) in Minimal preset on Windows to prevent unmanageable processes.
Fixed resumed update ready notice being improperly suppressed by earlier dismissals.
Fixed download-stage error classification and resolved potential deadlock on corrupted packages by falling back to retry.
Fixed sidebar whale logo click dispatch and anchor view synchronization.
itemsZh: 在 Windows 极简预设中禁用无 UI 控件的后台任务（run_in_background），避免产生无法停止的孤儿进程。
修复跨进程恢复的更新就绪通知因先前的关闭记录而被误静默的问题。
修复下载阶段失败时的状态记录分类，并增加损坏安装包自动降级重试以防死锁。
修复侧边栏深海鲸鱼 Logo 的点击事件分发与锚点视图同步问题。

itemsEn: Enhanced documentation with full portable directory layout tree, quick start guide, FAQ, and automated i18n synchronization check.
itemsZh: 完善中英文文档，补充完整便携包架构目录树、快速入门指引、常见问题 FAQ 及自动化中英文 i18n 校验工具。

history.body:
## Features / 主要功能

- Added PowerShell (pwsh) shell support and cmdline execution for the Minimal agent preset on Windows. / Windows 极简 Agent 预设支持 PowerShell (pwsh) 执行器与 cmdline 命令行适配。
- Adopted immersive titlebar layout with safe content top offset and draggable region. / 采用沉浸式标题栏布局，增加顶部安全内容边距与窗口拖拽区域。
- Reworked update and rollback feedback with automatic app relaunch and localized status cards. / 重构更新与回滚体验，支持回滚后自动重启恢复与多语言状态卡片。
- Added cross-restart Ready Resume for downloaded updates with package integrity verification. / 支持更新包就绪状态跨进程恢复（Ready Resume）与启动校验。

## Bug Fixes / 问题修复

- Disabled background jobs (run_in_background) in Minimal preset on Windows. / 极简预设禁用后台作业，防止孤儿进程。
- Fixed resumed update ready notice being improperly suppressed by earlier dismissals. / 修复就绪通知被误静默拦截的问题。
- Fixed download-stage error classification and prevented update stalling on corrupted packages. / 修复下载阶段报错分类与损坏包自动重试降级。
- Fixed sidebar whale logo click dispatch and anchor synchronization. / 修复侧边栏深海鲸鱼 Logo 点击分发与锚点同步。

## Documentation & Tooling / 文档与工具链

- Enhanced documentation with full directory layout tree, FAQ, and automated i18n check. / 完善架构目录树、FAQ 与自动化 i18n 同步校验。

history.name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.0

itemsEn: Portable Windows x64 package combining the native Electron desktop shell with an embedded DeepSeek Harness Web runtime.
Workspace selection, browser mode, tray/application menus, release history, About, and diagnostics export.
In-app update checking, download progress, SHA-256 verification, restart confirmation, and rollback support.
Native blue whale logo menu, Windows 11 Mica/title-bar styling, system theme synchronization, startup splash, and multi-monitor-safe window state.
itemsZh: 提供组合原生 Electron 桌面外壳与内置 DeepSeek Harness Web runtime 的 Windows x64 便携包。
支持工作区选择、浏览器模式、托盘/应用菜单、更新历史、关于信息和诊断导出。
支持应用内检查更新、下载进度、SHA-256 校验、重启确认和回滚。
提供蓝色原生鲸鱼 Logo 菜单、Windows 11 Mica/标题栏样式、系统主题同步、启动过渡页，以及适配多显示器的窗口状态记忆。

itemsEn: The desktop shell, embedded Web runtime, and release package are rebuilt from the pinned vendor/deepseek-harness source workspace included in this repository.
Release packaging validates the runtime source copy, release manifest, portable archive layout, required native modules, and SHA-256 checksums before publication.
The package includes Chinese and English quick guides, portable start/update scripts, and an uninstall flow that keeps user data unless deletion is explicitly confirmed.
itemsZh: 桌面外壳、内置 Web runtime 和发行包均基于仓库内固定的 vendor/deepseek-harness 源码 workspace 重新构建。
发布前会校验 runtime 源码一致性、发布清单、便携包目录布局、必要的原生模块和 SHA-256 校验和。
安装包包含中英文快速指南、便携启动/更新脚本，以及默认保留用户数据、仅在明确确认后删除数据的卸载流程。
